description: This file defines the class MarketplaceCatalogClient which extends AwsClient. It serves as a client for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Catalog Service, providing method signatures for various operations like batchDescribeEntities, cancelChangeSet, deleteResourcePolicy, describeChangeSet, describeEntity, getResourcePolicy, listChangeSets, listEntities, listTagsForResource, putResourcePolicy, startChangeSet, tagResource, and untagResource, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: MarketplaceCatalogClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Marketplace Catalog Service, extending the generic AwsClient to provide specific methods for this service.

methods.name: batchDescribeEntities
methods.description: Prepares to describe multiple entities in the AWS Marketplace Catalog.

methods.name: cancelChangeSet
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing change set operation.

methods.name: deleteResourcePolicy
methods.description: Deletes the resource policy associated with a resource.

methods.name: describeChangeSet
methods.description: Provides details about a specific change set.

methods.name: describeEntity
methods.description: Describes a single entity in the AWS Marketplace Catalog.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the resource policy attached to a resource.

methods.name: listChangeSets
methods.description: Lists change sets in the AWS Marketplace Catalog.

methods.name: listEntities
methods.description: Lists entities present in the AWS Marketplace Catalog.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Attaches a resource policy to a resource.

methods.name: startChangeSet
methods.description: Starts a new change set in the AWS Marketplace Catalog.
